name: CaseComboboxOptionSelected
description: SEED contract for the CSS/DOM conformance fixture case "combobox-option-selected" (combobox). The fixture varies CSS CONSTRUCTS, not prop spaces, so the prop space is deliberately EMPTY: every axis the capture would enumerate is held at nothing, and the whole measurement is the computed truth of one mounted rendering. Construct: 5 sibling options where ONE is SELECTED - a distinct fill (rgb(219, 234, 254)) and weight among four identical siblings
